field_notes.faction: Primary operator the content represents (usa, russia, china, japan, australia, europe, france, italy, spain, iran, multi, civilian, utility)
field_notes.type: framework | weapons | fixed-wing | rotary | uav | ship | submarine | land | airbase | patch (modifies other mods or vanilla units) | civilian | campaign (a third-party mission or campaign pack that ships no units of its own)
field_notes.requires: Dependencies from the mod description; entries marked (inferred) are this repo's inference, not an author statement
field_notes.load_order: Author's explicit placement instruction only (quoted); repo recommendations live in notes
field_notes.overlaps: Other mods in this list covering the same platform or files (conflict watch)
field_notes.workshop_id: Steam Workshop item id — the join key. It is the folder name under mods-source/ and the token used in data/load-order.tokens.txt, so this field is what links a catalog entry to its exported files, its load-order position and the checkers. Before it existed the id lived in prose in notes ("Workshop 3502273861").
field_notes.local_packs: SEST packs built in this repo. folder is the pack directory name (its load-order token and its name under StreamingAssets); source is the integration/ directory whose builder produces it.
